highlights.title: The Assigner keeps a task tree with one agent
highlights.line: The Assigner no longer hands a subtask to a second agent while another agent is working on its task tree.

highlights.title: Idle agents hear which scheduled run is due
highlights.line: When a repeating task's run is due, an idle agent's reminder names that run and tells it how to record it.

highlights.title: Taken-back posts say if they may still be up
highlights.line: Your list of community posts now says when a post that was taken back may still be public, instead of showing it as gone.
